docstring: Variant using the exact simultaneous double product property from [CKS05, 4.1].
references: [CKS05] Cohn, H., Kleinberg, R., Szegedy, B., and Umans, C. "Group-theoretic Algorithms for Matrix Multiplication" (Problem 4.7)
type_pretty:
True ↔
  ∀ ε > 0,
    ∃ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
      ∃ H x,
        ∃ (_ : Finite H),
          ∃ A B,
            ↑n ^ (2 - ε) ≤ ↑(Nat.card H) ∧
              ↑(Nat.card H) ≤ ↑n ^ (2 + ε) ∧
                (∀ (i : Fin n), ↑n ^ (2 - ε) ≤ ↑(A i).card * ↑(B i).card) ∧ Green36.SimultaneousDoubleProduct A B
